text:
support_lead: Heads up — Acme (tenant acme-123) reporting ~6hr gap in console usage rows for 2026-03-16. Customer says last visible data at ~01:55 UTC.
customer_success: They attached screenshots and a CSV export. API call logs look 200 for events around 02:00.
eng_data: Can you paste a sample request id / timespan? I’ll start tracing.
support_lead: Sample: tenant=acme-123, date=2026-03-16, missing hours 02:00–08:00. Example request id=req_9f8a, seen 2026-03-16T02:10:23Z 200 OK in API logs.
eng_sre: Noted. I see a backfill job restart from deploy-bot around 02:05 that might coincide.
deploy-bot: Backfill job "hourly-rollup-replay" started by eng_data at 2026-03-16T02:06:12Z (run id: backfill-20260316-02)
analytics: We recorded a consumer-lag spike on topic "usage-ingest-hourly" starting ~02:03. consumer_group=usage-rollup-v2 lag peaked ~1.2M offsets between 02:10–04:20.
eng_data: Querying ETL logs now. Seeing repeated validation errors then retries:
```
2026-03-16T02:12:07Z ERROR rollup: schema validation failed: missing column "customer_tier" for tenant acme-123
2026-03-16T02:12:07Z WARN rollup: retrying in 10s (attempt 1)
2026-03-16T02:12:17Z WARN rollup: retrying in 30s (attempt 2)
```
eng_data: Looks like a schema migration landed at ~01:58 that added a nullable column. Backfill runner didn't include the migration step and started replaying raw events, hitting validation and backing off, but still consuming partitions and preventing real-time consumers from progressing.
ops_oncall: I restarted the consumer group at 04:40 to rebalance, but the backfill process was still saturating I/O so lag didn't recover quickly.
ops_oncall: Throttled backfill to 50% at 04:55 and scaled rollup workers x2. Real-time consumers started catching up; hourly rows for 05:00 and 06:00 are now appearing.
support_lead: Customer update sent: apologised, explained transient backfill collision, credited 10% of month + ETA for full catch-up.
customer_success: Customer accepted the credit, asked for root cause and mitigation plan.
analytics: Root cause summary: schema change + uncoordinated backfill start = validation failures + exponential retry occupying consumer group and causing multi-hour lag. Also missing alerting for sustained consumer lag during backfills.
eng_data: Created GH issue #4422: "Backfill runner must detect schema migrations and pause or coordinate with migration plan".
eng_sre: Action items — postmortem draft (support_lead), backfill pre-checks + rate limiter (eng_data), alerting threshold for consumer lag >30m (eng_sre). Owners assigned.
support_lead: Also adding a quick mitigation: backfill runner should check migration-state endpoint before starting and abort with a clear alarm.
eng_data: Will add migration pre-check and fail-fast w/metric by end of sprint.
ops_oncall: Monitoring: setting a temporary dashboard panel to watch "usage-rollup-v2" lag and producer bytes. :eyes:
support_lead: Thanks all. I'll own the postmortem and customer comms. Will follow up when GH PRs are up. :thumbsup:
eng_sre: Good catch. Closing thread once postmortem and alerting PRs merged.
